bayts.text: My praise and my gratitude (go) to Him through Whom my whole being has become, for Him, contentment without displeasure, at Ṣarṣāra (in Mauritania).
To Him are my praise and my contentment without displeasure, ever since He led supporters to me from among the Banū Daymān.
To Allah (belongs) my whole being, at the wells of nobility, from which we departed, and where many were those who visited (me).
Truly those who made their way to Ṣarṣāra to visit me have parted, in the two Abodes, from their sins.
